subject.title: fix(feishu): bound Feishu API JSON response reads to prevent OOM

question: Should this broader Feishu bounded-read PR be the canonical landing path, with the 16 MiB fail-closed cap accepted for app-registration/owner and streaming-card JSON responses?
rationale: The code shape and proof are strong, but only maintainers can accept the compatibility boundary and coordinate overlapping Feishu PRs.

options.title: Accept this broad branch
options.body: Land this PR after normal maintainer review if the 16 MiB cap is acceptable across Feishu app-registration/owner and streaming-card JSON paths.

options.title: Prefer the narrow streaming-card branch
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99792 to land first and leave app-registration hardening separate.

options.title: Tune cap or scope
options.body: Adjust the cap or covered call sites first if Feishu can legitimately return successful control-plane JSON above the shared provider limit.

recommendation.title: Accept this broad branch
recommendation.body: Land this PR after normal maintainer review if the 16 MiB cap is acceptable across Feishu app-registration/owner and streaming-card JSON paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history on Feishu app-registration and streaming-token behavior, making this the best available owner for the cap and overlap decision.
